title: Fear
html:
Fear Effects

Whilst roaming around dungeons you will encounter many an enemy with the abilty to cast a fear effect upon you. This causes your character to run in an opposite direction. Whils under the effect your character can no longer use buffs , stop running and can't attack an opponent.

Character Curses

This skill can be purchased from Gwen of the tree folk in townston and is called fear shot. It has the ability to be upgraded and can have an effect which lasts for a total of 11 seconds when maxed out and requires a ranged wepon to use.

The skill is popular amoung most ranger PvP builds as even the lowest level of fear shot can be used in most tactics for several different things. Wether it is to do fast damage without taking dame yourself or as an escape plan for when things get a little close.

Fighters have a similar curse creating the same effect. The fear of gosh and this can be purchased from lothar of the mound people in townston.
